name: Phase Range Optimization for Simultaneous Color
aliases: Phase Range Optimization for Simultaneous Color — Differentiated Phase Range RGB Holography, RGB Phase Range Optimization
definition: Ensuring phase ranges for each of the three color channels are sufficiently different to produce unique holograms in each channel, overcoming depth-wavelength ambiguity associated with the ASM kernel.
summary: Phase Range Optimization for Simultaneous Color determines optimal per-channel phase ranges to resolve depth-wavelength ambiguity while minimizing phase excursion to preserve bit depth and refresh rate.
